Title: Nikhil's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Nikhil - 11 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Hema - 42 years, mother
Look: green saree

Places

1. The bathroom - a tap, a bucket, a mirror
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The bathroom - Day

[Nikhil stands in the bathroom. Hema stands near him.]

Nikhil: "Today feels like a good day."

[Nikhil brushes his teeth at the sink.]

Nikhil (happily): "This is amazing!"

[Nikhil takes a quick bath.]

Nikhil (surprised): "And then?"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Nikhil stands in the courtyard. Hema stands near him.]

Nikhil: "So, here we are!"

[Nikhil walks across the courtyard.]

Nikhil: "Mom, listen!"

[Nikhil hides behind the tree.]

Hema (softly): "This is amazing!"

[Nikhil carries his school bag on his back.]

Nikhil: "And then?"

[A strong wind starts blowing.]

Hema (surprised): "This is amazing!"

[Dark clouds gather in the sky.]

Hema (excited): "I really enjoyed today."
